$comment: GET /v2/conferenceRecords/{conferenceRecordId}/transcripts/{transcriptId}/entries -- verified against the Meet API v2 Discovery Document 2026-09-16. The actual spoken-word text, one entry per continuous utterance, in order. This is POST-MEETING only -- Meet's stable REST API has no live/streaming transcript; that is the Media API's job, developer-preview and out of scope here (see the provider's own $comment).
title: List transcript entries
description: Read a finished conference's transcript, one utterance per entry.

config.label: Conference record ID
config.description: The id from conference_record_list's data.conferenceRecords[].name (give the id after conferenceRecords/).

config.label: Transcript ID
config.description: The id from transcript_list's data.transcripts[].name (give the id after transcripts/).

outputShape.description: This page's entries, in order. Each has name, participant (participants/{id} -- join against participant_list to get a display name), text (the spoken words), languageCode, startTime and endTime.
Present when there is another page.
